description: Generates customized client onboarding checklists with phased tasks, ownership assignments, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and email templates. Adapts to consulting, SaaS, or agency engagement models. Prepare a task-specific, evidence-linked draft and identify unresolved fact

provenance.author: LiNKskills adaptation
provenance.source: Complete pinned upstream task tree and notices retained byte-for-byte in references/upstream/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json
provenance.license: Exact source notices and license evidence are preserved per source; Carlos handles licensing.

routing.when_to_use: Generates customized client onboarding checklists with phased tasks, ownership assignments, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and email templates. Adapts to consulting, SaaS, or agency engagement models. Return the draft, evidence trace, and uncertainties.
when_not_to_use: A different, distinct task is requested
An unapproved external effect, final decision, signature or system mutation is required
exclusion_rules: No invented company facts, policy, law, authority, approval or jurisdiction
Foreign jurisdiction material is conditional and not generalized
ambiguity_rules: Read authorized evidence; ask only materially outcome-changing questions; complete separable work

required_inputs.name: source_documents
required_inputs.description: Authorized document, record, or evidence references.

required_inputs.name: company_or_matter_facts
required_inputs.description: Founder-confirmed facts and company/matter context; unknowns remain explicit.

required_inputs.name: jurisdiction_and_as_of
required_inputs.description: Only actual jurisdiction(s) supplied or established from authoritative evidence, plus as-of date. Null when not applicable/known.

required_inputs.name: approved_positions_or_policy_ref
required_inputs.description: Approved policy/playbook/position reference, if supplied; absence is not permission to invent one.

required_inputs.name: client_onboarding_checklist_task_payload
required_inputs.description: Required task-specific fields: engagement_model_and_scope, client_and_internal_owners, start_dates_access_and_deliverables, acceptance_criteria_and_exclusions. Every field carries fact_status, value, and evidence_refs; use fact_status=unknown with null value when the evidence is unavailable.

expected_outputs.name: client_onboarding_checklist_work_product
expected_outputs.description: Produce the source task deliverable stated in the entrypoint, marked as a draft where approval is needed; upstream Markdown does not declare interoperable typed LiNKskills output fields. Produce this task’s distinct requested artifact.

forbidden_actions: Unapproved external effects, signatures, filings, legal commitments or source-system mutations
Inventing facts, jurisdiction, legal authority, company policy or approval
Exposure of confidential or personal data outside authorized scope
verification_steps: Check every material conclusion against evidence and record source/date/location.
Distinguish fact, allegation, interpretation, proposal and unknown.
Verify jurisdiction-specific current primary authority where legal conclusion depends on law; otherwise report the precise gap.
Validate task contract and keep external_effects and mutations empty.
Use only current visible native tool schemas; report unsupported interface gaps.
completion_criteria: Distinct task deliverable meets typed contract and task-specific acceptance criteria
Evidence, date/applicability, uncertainty and reviewer/owner decisions are visible
No unapproved external effects or mutations
known_limitations: Draft and uncertified; structural checks are not semantic or legal certification
No current legal database or business interface is assumed

telemetry.retention_policy: opaque task/source ids and hashes only
